synopsis: special instructions for character creation phase, uses =Карточная_Система= to generate stats

body.priority: CRITICAL - if you see this quant, character creation process is priority
body.instruction_for_gm:
You see this quant ONLY during character creation.

**WHAT TO DO:**
1. System draws 5 cards for stat distribution (see =Значение_Карт=)
2. Explain distribution rules from =Характеристики=
3. Player distributes 4 best cards (worst discarded) to 4 stats
4. Value = rank × 5 (+10 if suit matches characteristic)
5. Return final stats in response_data

**AFTER CREATION:**
- DON'T request this quant again
- Request =Карточная_Система=, =Проверки=, =Боевая_Система= as needed
body.instruction_for_quantizer:
DON'T create 'Character' or 'Inventory' quants - they are in game mechanics!

Instead create quants for:
1. UNIQUE character abilities (e.g., 'Магический_Призыв')
2. Important backstory elements (e.g., 'Предыстория_Героя')
3. Special items with lore

synopsis: core card-based RPG system 'Factorial 52!', uses standard 52-card deck for all checks and combat via =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=

body.description: Card-based tabletop RPG system. All actions resolved by drawing cards. No dice needed - only standard 52-card deck.
body.core_principle: Cards are drawn BEFORE player declares action. GM sees results and uses them for narrative. Player describes intent, GM interprets based on drawn cards.
body.card_drawing: Always draw 2 cards as a pair. Bot draws 2 pairs (4 cards) per turn for flexibility.
body.bot_adaptations: Cards dealt randomly before turn. GM sees check results and uses them for luck/skill checks in narrative. Combat uses card pair (unlike tabletop single-card).

links.Значение_Карт: card rank values and face card meanings
links.Особые_События: special results from aces, twos, face cards

synopsis: card rank values: 2-10 face value, J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=15; face cards add narrative elements via =Особые_События=

body.narrative_use: Face cards (J, Q, K) can introduce NPCs, plot twists, or thematic elements. GM uses these for storytelling enrichment in peaceful time.

links.Особые_События: face cards and critical combos trigger special events

links.Характеристики: each suit corresponds to one characteristic

synopsis: four character stats from =Система_Мастей=: Сила(♠), Магия(♥), Стойкость(♦), Ловкость(♣); used in =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=

body.starting_values: Typically 25-85 range. Card rank × 5 (+10 if suit matches).
body.average_stat: Sum of all 4 stats ÷ 4. Used to calculate difficulty thresholds.

synopsis: out-of-combat skill checks using =Карточная_Система=: 2 cards × 10 + stat + =Бонусы_Мастей= vs difficulty threshold

body.when_to_check: When outcome is uncertain. Simple/obvious actions auto-succeed. Risky/difficult actions require check.

formula.step3: Add suit/color bonus per card (+20 suit match, +10 color match)

body.example: Jumping chasm (hard, agility). Difficulty: 200 + 40 = 240. Cards: 8♥ + K♠ = (80+130) + 60 agility = 270. Success!
body.gm_interpretation: GM sees pre-drawn cards and their check results. Uses appropriate check for the action player describes.

synopsis: combat resolution via =Карточная_Система=: black cards(♠♣)=attack, red cards(♥♦)=defense; damage = attack - defense

combat_flow.step1: Cards dealt to all participants (2 per entity in bot version)
combat_flow.step2: Players declare actions WITHOUT knowing their cards

attack_types.melee: Uses ♠ Spades/Strength. Close combat, swords, fists.
attack_types.ranged: Uses ♣ Clubs/Agility. Bows, guns, thrown weapons.

body.damage_formula: Attack total - Defense total = Damage dealt
body.value_calculation: Card value (rank × 10) + characteristic + suit bonus (+20) or color bonus (+10)
body.combo_attacks: Can combine two stats (e.g., magic + strength for 'fire sword'). Both stats add, but if both cards are red - attack fails!
body.bot_adaptation: Uses pair of cards instead of single card. More dynamic combat with higher values.

synopsis: suit/color matching bonuses for =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=: suit match +20, color match +10 (mutually exclusive)

body.bonus_priority: Suit match takes precedence over color match. Cannot stack both.
body.suit_match: +20 bonus when card suit matches the characteristic/action suit
body.color_match: +10 bonus when card color matches action type (but suit doesn't match)

examples.suit_match: Using ♠7 for Strength check: +20 bonus (spades = strength)
examples.color_match: Using ♣7 for Strength check: +10 bonus (both black, but clubs ≠ spades)
examples.no_bonus: Using ♥7 for Strength check: no bonus (red ≠ black)

synopsis: special card combinations for narrative: 2 Aces=divine success, 2 Twos=catastrophe, face cards=plot elements; uses =Значение_Карт=

body.applies_to: ONLY player characters, ONLY in peaceful time (not combat for NPCs)

two_aces.name: Divine Success / Божественный успех
two_aces.effect: Miraculous outcome. Divine intervention, impossible luck, legendary feat.
two_aces.example_peaceful: Recognized as 'Great Hero from prophecy', gifted sacred artifact
two_aces.example_combat: Accidental spell causes meteor to destroy enemy army, meteor itself is valuable

two_twos.name: Catastrophe / Катастрофа
two_twos.effect: Worst possible outcome. Everything goes wrong.
two_twos.example_peaceful: Falsely accused of murder, imprisoned, sentenced to death
two_twos.example_combat: Enemy summons demon lord, must flee for life

jack.meaning: Plot twist, unexpected event, NPC appearance
jack.use: GM introduces new story element or character

queen.use: Female NPC becomes significant, feminine themes emerge

king.use: Male NPC becomes significant, masculine themes emerge

body.gm_guidance: Use face cards for narrative enrichment. They suggest themes but don't force specific outcomes.

synopsis: equipment system tied to =Система_Мастей=: items have suit affinity, bonus = rank × 5 (+10 suit match), max 1 equipped per suit

item_mechanics.suit_affinity: Each item belongs to one suit (♠ weapons, ♥ magical items, ♦ armor, ♣ ranged/tools)
item_mechanics.value_discovery: Item stats unknown until 'identified' - draw card, rank × 5 (+10 if suit matches)
item_mechanics.equip_limit: Can only wear 1 item of each suit type. Others stay in inventory.

body.effect: Equipped item bonus adds to corresponding characteristic for all checks and combat.
body.inventory: Unlimited storage, but only equipped items grant bonuses.
body.stacking: Consumables stack (Potion_X3). Using one decrements count.

synopsis: character progression via =Проверки= success: +1 XP per successful check, at 10 XP: +1 stat, +1 HP, +1 Mana

body.xp_gain: Each successful check grants +1 XP to the characteristic used.
body.tracking: Each of 4 characteristics has separate XP counter (spades_xp, hearts_xp, etc.)
body.average_recalculation: After stat increase, average_stat should be recalculated. Affects difficulty thresholds.
body.alternative_progression: GM can award direct stat increases for training, special events, or story rewards.
body.death_rule: Death is permanent. If character dies, create new one. Keep notes for potential reuse in future games.

synopsis: isekai magic works through Mana (=Характеристики= ♥Hearts×3), regenerates with rest; multiple schools available via =Гильдия_Авантюристов=

mana_mechanics.source: Internal magical energy present in all living beings
mana_mechanics.exhaustion: Exceeding mana limit causes fatigue, unconsciousness, or death

magic_schools.necromancy: Dark arts, forbidden in most kingdoms

body.racial_affinity: Different races have natural predisposition to certain magic types
body.learning: Through academies, mentors, ancient tomes, or natural talent awakening

links.Боевая_Система: magic used in combat via Hearts stat

synopsis: adventurer organization with rank system F→S, provides quests and services; ranks affect =Проверки= difficulty access

body.description: Central organization for adventurers in isekai worlds. Hub for quests, information, and services.

rank_system.F: Novice - basic fetch quests, herb gathering
rank_system.C: Average - standard adventurer, most quests available
rank_system.S: Legendary - world-threatening events, heroes of renown

body.rank_up: Complete appropriate quests, demonstrate skill, pass evaluation. Higher ranks unlock better quests and rewards.

synopsis: isekai world races and creatures: humans, elves, dwarves, beastfolk, demons; monsters from slimes to dragons; affects =Магическая_Система= affinity

playable_races.humans: Versatile, no special bonuses, adaptable to any role
playable_races.beastfolk: Animal traits, agility affinity (♣+), various sub-types (cat, wolf, fox, etc.)

monster_types.weak: Slimes, goblins, wolves - F-E rank quests
monster_types.moderate: Orcs, ogres, undead - D-C rank quests
monster_types.strong: Trolls, wyverns, golems - B-A rank quests
monster_types.legendary: Dragons, demon lords, ancient evils - S rank quests

body.creature_traits: Each race/monster has typical habitat, abilities, weaknesses. GM should consider these in encounters.

synopsis: isekai genre conventions: otherworld knowledge advantage, unique abilities, game-like elements; affects =Проверки= interpretation

transfer_types.reincarnation: Death in original world, rebirth in new one
transfer_types.summoning: Deliberately called by ritual or deity

otherworld_advantage.knowledge: Modern science, technology, tactics unknown in fantasy world
otherworld_advantage.unique_ability: Often granted special power during transfer (by god, system, etc.)
otherworld_advantage.perspective: Different worldview can solve problems locals can't

common_tropes.system_awareness: Recognizing RPG mechanics others take for granted

body.gm_guidance: Player can leverage Earth knowledge. Create quants for specific advantages when used creatively.
